identity.name: Letta
identity.one_liner: Platform for stateful agents with advanced memory, personalization, and learning over time.
identity.short_description: Letta is an open-source platform for building stateful agents that remember users, maintain memory blocks, and interact through APIs and SDKs.

positioning.why_it_matters: Letta matters because memory is not just a database problem; it changes how an agent behaves over time. Letta gives builders a more structured model for stateful agents and persistent memory.
best_for: Teams that need memory APIs and SDKs instead of ad hoc context prompts
Researchers exploring learning and self-improving agents
not_for: Users who want a fully managed consumer product with no setup work
Teams that cannot review the linked source, license, and operational requirements before adoption

core_strengths.title: Stateful agent model
core_strengths.description: Letta treats memory as part of the agent state rather than a loose prompt append.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: That makes it easier to build agents that remain coherent across sessions.

core_strengths.title: API and SDK surface
core_strengths.description: Letta provides APIs and client SDKs for integrating stateful agents into applications.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Product teams need stable interfaces, not just demos.

core_strengths.title: Active open-source platform
core_strengths.description: The project has frequent releases and documentation around agents and memory.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Active maintenance matters for infrastructure that sits inside an application.

seo_article.intro: Letta is an open-source platform for building stateful agents that remember users, maintain memory blocks, and interact through APIs and SDKs.
seo_article.what_it_is: Letta is an open memory-system resource to evaluate by what it stores, how recall works, how memory is scoped, and whether users or teams can inspect, correct, export, or delete durable context.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Letta matters because memory is not just a database problem; it changes how an agent behaves over time. Letta gives builders a more structured model for stateful agents and persistent memory.
seo_article.how_it_works: Test Letta with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: What should I check before using Letta?
faq.answer: Test Letta with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: Is Letta open source?
faq.answer: Letta is listed with Apache-2.0 based on the official source links in this profile. Re-check the repository, model card, or docs before production use.

faq.question: Who should evaluate Letta?
faq.answer: Letta is most worth evaluating for developers building personalized stateful agents.
